message: 素
I wonder if Sally-chan and Eauderourke are working diligently? Let's go check on them for a bit.

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Uga? Me don't know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't be so mean and please tell me. A gluttonous sumo wrestler like you ought to know.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me. Not wrestler. Don't know.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, Loro-chi, isn't that enough already? Boss and I are on our way back from a delivery, you know.」
Lolotte has caught Eauderourke and is pressing him for answers.

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, it's Prez. Hiya~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, what are the three of you doing gathered together?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, help.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Sumo Wrestler is quite the spoiled child, isn't he. I'm not bullying him, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Bleh! If our beef bowls get cold, it's gonna be all your fault, Loro-chi.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Didn't you already finish your delivery?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Manager made staff meal for us, waiting.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah~, I wanna hurry back and eat my beef bowl.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I won't let you escape. Mr. Sumo Wrestler and Ms. Tag-Along are hiding something from me, aren't you?」

name: Sally
message: 「We aren't, geez~」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, I don't know the circumstances, but it's not good to suspect people without reason.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu... I haven't done anything wrong. Please listen to me, Mr. President. Actually--」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofu~, while Prez has Loro-chi tied up... tip-tap, skedaddle~♪」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Tap, tap, tap♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff, sniff... Leaving right in the middle of things, Mr. Demon is so cruel~~」

name: Synn
message: 「They're working hard, so you shouldn't get in their way.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hic... I wasn't causing any trouble at all. I was just asking for directions.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah!! Come to think of it, Mr. Chairman, you're a master shopper! You know where it is, don't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where is the su-udon shop?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're looking for an udon shop, go straight down this way--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. I'm looking for a su-udon restaurant.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As I imagine it, it's a specialty shop where you eat udon with vinegar. There's no mistake about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, where's Riesling?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「......? Jiiya vanished just a moment ago. Like, poof.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wanted to eat su-udon with him, but... oh, right, please come along in his place, Mr. Chairman♪」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte, do you know what kake-soba is?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? I'm bad at math, you know.」
O-Oh boy, how am I supposed to explain this?

name: Riesling
message: 「Thank you for waiting.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay\s07 I knew you'd definitely come.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the preparations for Milady's vinegar udon making to me, your butler Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「......Preparations?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Even with the Rosenkreuz family's intelligence network, the existence of a vinegar udon specialty shop could not be confirmed.」

name: Riesling
message: 「In its stead, I have stocked the kitchen of Grand Palace Sakura with four servings of udon along with various vinegars and seasonings.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why at my place!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Much obliged.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! I want to make vinegar udon. How exciting, how thrilling.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, let us head over at once. I won't let you escape.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you talking about me?」
Driven in a luxury car to the experimental kitchen for creative cuisine.
Lolotte and I repeatedly taste-tested as we mixed together various vinegars and seasonings.
As a result, through a stroke of luck that could practically be called a miracle, we created a delicious dipping sauce and savored our self-proclaimed vinegar udon.
...However, we were never able to recreate the sauce we made that day, and it became a legendary flavor to me, Lolotte, and Riesling-san.
And for some reason, Riesling-san joined our party!!
